Home.heroDesc: Plan your finances. Keep track of your budget. Explore the world – FinanceAbroad helps students and expats stay on top of their spending abroad.
Home.previewLabel: Example · Your budget at a glance
Home.featuresDesc: Whether it's a semester abroad, work & travel, or life as a long-term expat – FinanceAbroad has you covered.
Home.feature1Desc: Built for semesters abroad and scholarships. Budgets based on your grant or scholarship amount.
Home.feature2Desc: Manage accounts in multiple countries and currencies at once – always up to date.
Home.feature3Desc: Create budgets for rent, food and leisure. Keep track of your spending with clear charts.
Home.feature4Desc: Your data is end-to-end encrypted. No ads, no data sharing.
Home.step1Desc: Sign up for free – in under 2 minutes.
Home.step2Desc: Set your monthly budget for each category.
Home.step3Desc: Log expenses manually or sync with your bank.
Home.ctaDesc: Start with FinanceAbroad today and keep your finances abroad under control.
